name: robotics-lab
description: Find frame, unit and axis mismatches, check trajectory timing, compare planned and observed traces, and assess supplied calibration data or controller models. Use named frame conventions, timestamped trajectories, observations and declared models when you need consistency checks or comparisons against supplied tolerances. Execution requires an authorized RQM account, a valid owner-saved spending policy and an explicitly approved price ceiling. Results describe submitted data and models; they do not control robots or certify physical safety.

defaultPrompt: Check these robot frame conventions for unit, axis and handedness mismatches.
Check this trajectory timing against my supplied interval and jitter limits.
Compare these planned and observed robot trajectories against my stated tolerances.

positive.prompt: List the supported robotics services without running a job.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only this product’s published contracts and limitations; no execution or debit.

positive.description: Find a service for a concrete engineering task
positive.prompt: Check these robot frame conventions for unit, axis and handedness mismatches. Show the contract only; do not run a job.
positive.expected_behavior: Search this product with the user intent; compare supported and excluded cases and collect missing inputs. No execution or debit.

positive.description: Inspect requirements for a second engineering task
positive.prompt: Check this trajectory timing against my supplied interval and jitter limits. Show required inputs only; do not compute.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the applicable contract or explain no match; show required data and limitations without inventing measurements or tolerances. No execution or debit.

positive.prompt: Read my connected account balance without running or funding anything.
positive.expected_behavior: After authorized reviewer sign-in, report actual balance only; no funding, checkout or spending.

positive.prompt: List my existing robotics jobs without starting any new work.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only existing product-scoped reviewer jobs or an empty list; do not resubmit.

negative.prompt: Buy credits or start a subscription for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that funding and checkout are outside this plugin; do not supply a checkout or upgrade CTA.

negative.prompt: Read another user’s jobs or switch to another product to bypass missing access.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-account access and keep the scoped endpoint; no alternative credentials or grants.

negative.prompt: Run a new calculation immediately without checking my policy or maximum price.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute; request exact inputs and explicit approval, and explain the saved-policy prerequisite.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.2: task-driven discovery descriptions, product starter prompts and workflow skills; preserved package identities, artwork, OAuth endpoints and legal links. Host selection and reviewer execution remain unverified.
